knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the agent or tenant buys a clean that matches the agreed list, with the certainty that the list has been checked and a return visit for missed items. A bond refund is not sold, and an hourly rate on its own is not an offer.

The lesson says that in Victoria a provider cannot ask a renter to get professional cleaning unless the property must be returned to its starting state or needs professional cleaning. Checking that test comes before any quote.
The lesson says the cleaner does not control the landlord's claim process, so a bond refund cannot be promised. The lesson also says pass rates were not found, so no pass should be promised.
